request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn it into a chocolate-bar boat: the hull becomes a dark chocolate bar #5a3423 marked into square blocks with a thick rim of pale pink frosting #ffb8d8; the red sail becomes a pale biscuit wafer #e9c98f with a waffle grid; the mast becomes a pink and white striped candy cane; the pennant becomes pale pink. Nothing red. Keep the boat shape, size, waterline, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
